mapper.select: SELECT g.*, c.name AS category_name, u.username, u.nickname FROM lost_goods g LEFT JOIN category c ON g.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE g.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lost_goods(title, image, category_id, place, lost_time, description, type, user_id, audit_status, create_time) VALUES(#{title}, #{image}, #{categoryId}, #{place}, #{lostTime}, #{description}, #{type}, #{userId}, IFNULL(#{auditStatus}, 0), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE lost_goods SET audit_status = #{auditStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM lost_goods GROUP BY type
